properties.name: entity_id
properties.description: The globally unique, system-generated surrogate identifier. Never changes over the lifetime of the entity. This is the stable join key used across every system, report, and integration that references this entity. Business keys (employee number, invoice number) may change; entity_id does not.

properties.name: consent_id
properties.description: Natural key of the consent record.

properties.name: person
properties.description: The person who gave the consent.

properties.name: consent_type
properties.description: What the consent covers.
properties.valueDefinitions:
DATA_PROCESSING: Processing of personal data for employment purposes.
MONITORING: Workplace monitoring.
PHOTO: Use of the person's image.
BACKGROUND_CHECK: A pre-employment or periodic background check.

properties.name: granted_at
properties.description: When the consent was given.

properties.name: withdrawn_at
properties.description: When the consent was withdrawn; empty while it stands.

properties.name: purpose_scope
properties.description: The purpose and scope the consent was given for.

properties.name: lawful_basis
properties.description: Lawful basis for processing (for example consent, contract, legal obligation).

properties.name: retention_period
properties.description: How long data covered by this consent is kept.

properties.name: document_type
properties.description: Classification of the document (template, policy, specification, ...).

properties.name: version
properties.description: Version identifier (SemVer or other scheme).

properties.name: content_reference
properties.description: Optional URI to the document's contents (if stored externally).

properties.name: replaces_document
properties.description: Predecessor document this supersedes.

properties.name: natural_identifiers
properties.description: Zero or more natural (business) keys that identify this entity. Each carries its own scheme and issuer so multiple identifier systems can coexist without conflict.

properties.name: created_at
properties.description: Timestamp when this entity record was created.

properties.name: created_by
properties.description: Actor who created this entity record. May be a user identifier, system identifier, or service account name.

properties.name: last_modified_at
properties.description: Timestamp of last modification to this entity record.

properties.name: last_modified_by
properties.description: Actor who last modified this entity record.

properties.name: lifecycle_state
properties.description: Current lifecycle state of the entity. Each entity has its own list of states, held on this attribute with the meaning of each value (D3).

properties.name: state_effective_from
properties.description: When the current lifecycle state became effective.

properties.name: state_effective_to
properties.description: When the current lifecycle state ceases to be effective (if known).

properties.name: state_history
properties.description: Immutable history of lifecycle state transitions. Appended to on every state change; never mutated in place.

collections.description: GDPR/CCPA consent a person has given (or withdrawn) for a stated purpose, such as data processing, monitoring or a background check. Withdrawal must be honoured and drives data lifecycle actions. Applies to employees and to candidates.
collections.sourceTaxonomyRef: HR / HR Compliance & Employee Relations / Employee Consent Record

collections.description: A human being. Stable identity whose relationships with the enterprise are expressed through Roles. A single Person entity persists across all engagements (hire, leave, return, convert to consultant) — entity_id never changes.

buckets.name: HRCompliance
buckets.description: HR subdomain HR Compliance. Origin of EmployeeConsentRecord, the consent a person gives for processing of their data; Talent Acquisition uses it for background-check consent.

properties.name: Foundation
properties.description: The permanent enterprise concepts. Entity is the root; Person, Organization (LegalEntity, OrganizationalUnit), Team, Role, Activity, Agreement, Asset, Address, Document and Period specialise it. Every Domain, Process and Application entity specialises exactly one of these kinds and carries its attributes (D12). Entity and Organization are never tables (edmAbstract).

properties.description: Last / family name.

properties.name: middle_names

properties.name: honorific_suffix
properties.description: Honorific suffix (Jr., Sr., III, PhD).

properties.name: preferred_name
properties.description: Name the person prefers to be called by.

properties.name: date_of_birth
properties.description: Date of birth.

properties.name: date_of_death
properties.description: Date of death (if applicable).

properties.name: gender_identity
properties.description: Self-reported gender identity. Free-text to respect individual self-description; avoid enumerated values that may be incomplete.

properties.name: pronouns
properties.description: Self-reported pronouns (e.g., "she/her", "they/them").

properties.name: nationality
properties.description: One or more nationalities held by this person. Format: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

properties.name: primary_language
properties.description: Primary language used for communication. Format: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code.

properties.name: additional_languages
properties.description: Additional languages spoken. Format: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code.

properties.name: email_addresses
properties.description: Personal email addresses. Work email belongs on the EmployeeRole in the Domain layer, not here.

properties.name: phone_numbers
properties.description: Personal phone numbers (E.164 format recommended).

properties.name: lifecycle_state
properties.description: Current lifecycle state of the entity. Each entity has its own list of states, held on this attribute with the meaning of each value (D3).
properties.valueDefinitions:
PROSPECT: Known to the enterprise but no formal engagement yet.
ACTIVE: Has at least one active Role with the enterprise.
INACTIVE: No currently-active Role but record remains.
MERGED: Record has been merged into another Person record.
ARCHIVED: Record is archived per data-retention policy.
DECEASED: Person is deceased; record retained for historical reference.

properties.description: Immutable history of lifecycle state transitions. Appended to on every state change; never mutated in place.

properties.description: The prior lifecycle state (as enum string value).

properties.name: to_state
properties.description: The new lifecycle state (as enum string value).

properties.description: When the transition occurred.

properties.name: transitioned_by_entity_type
properties.description: Entity type of transitioned by: one of Person, Role, Team. Polymorphic reference: no relationship (docs/patterns/polymorphic_references.md).

properties.name: transitioned_by_entity_id
properties.description: The actor responsible for the transition. Typically references a Person (via their entity_id), but may be a system/service account in automated transitions.

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Free-text reason or note explaining the transition.

properties.name: addresses
properties.description: Zero or more Address references. An entity may have multiple addresses (e.g., a customer with distinct billing and shipping addresses; a Person with home and work addresses).
